name: Dr. Amara Osei
title: Lead Clinical Psychologist
bio: Dr. Amara brings over 12 years of experience in evidence-based trauma therapy. She is passionate about creating safe, affirming spaces where clients can explore their inner world and build lasting resilience.

name: James Mwangi
title: Senior Counselling Psychologist
bio: James specialises in relationship and sexual health counselling, helping couples and individuals navigate intimacy challenges with empathy and clinical precision. He is trained in Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT).

name: Cynthia Njoroge
title: Psychologist & SGBV Specialist
bio: Cynthia is a trauma-informed psychologist with a decade of experience supporting survivors of sexual and gender-based violence. She combines evidence-based modalities with culturally sensitive care.

name: David Kamau
title: Career & Organisational Psychologist
bio: David bridges the worlds of psychology and organisational development, supporting individuals and teams through career transitions, burnout recovery, and skills assessments grounded in validated psychometrics.
